questions.q: How does Paul describe himself as he writes to Philemon?
questions.evidence: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker

questions.q: For whom does Paul plead with Philemon?
questions.evidence: I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus

questions.q: Paul asks Philemon to have him back as what?
questions.evidence: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord
